verdict.rationale: Vapi documents Composer, a first-party AI feature where you "describe what you want to build and Composer handles the technical setup," which addresses the core of AI-assisted agent authoring from a description. The evidence is a single thin line, though. It does not show Composer generating or improving prompts, flows, or test cases. The IDE-knowledge and MCP-server items rely on external AI assistants, and Evals and Test Suites are user-defined, so none of these count here. Missing for 10: documented prompt generation or improvement, flow generation, AI-generated test cases from a description, detailed Composer docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
